subject: Request: evaluation window reprieve & temporary sandbox top-up
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@opsly.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: evaluation window reprieve & temporary sandbox top-up

Hey Irene,

Hope you're well — quick one from our side. We're integrating Redwood into Opsly's ingestion pipeline this week but hit a blocker around our SSO / session token exchange. The engineering team is close, but the delay means our demo window (and available eval tokens) will run out before we can complete the end-to-end tests.

Would Redwood be open to granting a short reprieve on the evaluation window and a temporary sandbox top-up so we can finish validation? Ideally an extra 10–14 days plus ~300k tokens would get us across the finish line. If helpful I can share the integration logs and a quick list of failing exchanges.

We're targeting a production-ready demo for your team on the week of June 21, so this is time-sensitive. Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
Opsly Inc.
[Attachment: integration_log_excerpt.txt (text)]
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@opsly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-05T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation window reprieve & temporary sandbox top-up

Samir — thanks for the note and details. Sorry to hear about the SSO friction; we see that derail frequently when token exchange headers are stripped by intermediate proxies.

Quick asks from our side to speed approval:
- Can you paste the exact failing HTTP exchange (Authorization header redaction / 401 payload) or attach a representative log excerpt?
- Confirm the exact sandbox ID you're using (we've seen teams running on an older sandbox which can look like this).

I'll put you in touch with Ben on commercial approvals and Marissa for any environment-level changes. I can provision an emergency sandbox top-up while we review the logs — pending sign-off we can do a 14-day extension and a temporary 300k token supplement. If you can share the log now I'll start the internal OKs.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194
Redwood Inference

POST /auth/exchange HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.opsly.internal
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
